entries.source: This talent was recently learnt; you can still unlearn it if you are out of combat or in a quiet area like a #{bold}#town#{normal}#.

entries.source:
While Highers are not meant to rule other humans - and show no particular will to do so - they are frequently called to higher duties.
		Their nature grants them better senses than other humans.
		Increase blindness immunity by %d%%, maximum sight range by %d, and increases existing infravision, and heightened senses range by %d.
		At talent level 5, each time you hit a target you gain telepathy to all similar creatures in radius 15 for 5 turns.
entries.target:
虽然高等人类的高贵血统并不意味着统治他人——他们也没有特别的意愿去那样做——但是他们经常承担更高的义务。
		他们的本能使得他们比别人有更强的直觉。
		增加 %d%% 目盲免疫，提高 %d 点最大视野范围并提高 %d 夜视及感应范围。
		技能等级 5 时，每次你命中目标，你将获得 15 格范围内同类型生物感知能力，持续 5 回合。

entries.source: So you can infuse amulets in this place?
entries.target: 据说你可以给项链附魔？

entries.source:
Wait, @playername@, you seem to be quite the adventurer. Maybe we can help one another.
You see, I #{bold}#LOOOVVVEEEE#{normal}# learning new lore and finding old artifacts of power, but I am not exactly an adventurer and I would surely get killed out there.
So take this orb (#LIGHT_GREEN#*she gives you an orb of scrying*#WHITE#). You can use it to talk to me from anywhere in the world! This way you can show me your new shiny findings!
I get to see many interesting things, and you get to know what your items do. We both win! Isn't it sweet?
Oh yes, the orb will also identify mundane items for you, as long as you carry it.
entries.target:
等等，@playername@，你看起来是个相当了不起的冒险家。也许我们能互相帮助。
你看，我#{bold}#超——喜欢#{normal}#学习新的传说知识、搜寻古老强大的神器，但我自己可算不上什么冒险家，到外头去肯定会送命的。
所以拿着这颗水晶球吧（#LIGHT_GREEN#*她递给你一颗占卜水晶球*#WHITE#）。你可以在世界上的任何地方用它与我通话！这样你就能随时向我展示你新找到的闪亮宝贝了！
我能见识到许多有趣的事物，而你也能弄清楚物品的用途。我们双赢！这不是两全其美吗？
而且，只要你随身携带，这颗水晶球还会为你自动鉴定普通物品。

entries.source:
It seems the threads of time and space have been disrupted...
I will try to send you to safety.
entries.target:
时空之线似乎已被扰乱……
我会尽力将你送到安全的地方。

entries.target:
你吸收目标的能量并化为己用，最多使 %d 个随机技能进入 %d 回合冷却。
		每使一个技能进入冷却，你可以减少你处于冷却中的技能的冷却时间 %d 回合。

entries.source: The energy is too low. It needs to be at least 15.
entries.target: 能量过低，至少需要15点能量。

entries.source: Look at me, I'm playing a roguelike!

entries.target: 通用 暗影反击伤害
#DARK_GREEN#你感觉自己就是自然之怒的化身！

entries.source: Stopped a naga invasion by closing their portal.
entries.target: 关闭传送门来阻止娜迦入侵。

entries.source: Yes please, let me see your wares.
entries.target: 好的，让我看看你的货物。

entries.source: A large and muscled wolf from the northern wastes. Its breath is cold and icy, and its fur coated in frost.
entries.target: 一头来自北部荒野的狼，它膘肥身健，体型匀称。它呼吸冰冷，毛覆寒霜。

entries.source: Good adventurer, I am an alchemist, and quite a good one. This year, for the first time, the great Brotherhood of Alchemists has invited my application to their number. I'll not try your patience with the details of the application process, but suffice to say that it is grueling. Fortunately, a mere three tasks now stand between me and acceptance.
entries.target: 可敬的冒险者，我是一名炼金术士，而且手艺相当精湛。今年，伟大的炼金术士兄弟会首次邀请我申请入会。我就不用申请流程的细节来消磨你的耐心了，简而言之，那极其严苛。幸运的是，现在我与正式入会之间只剩下区区三项任务了。

entries.source: A small faceless humanoid with vaguely Dwarven features.  Its waraxe and shield look battered, rusted, and generally in ill repair.
entries.target: 一个没有面孔、身材矮小且带有部分矮人特征的人形怪物。它的战斧和盾牌看起来破旧、生锈，几乎从未修理过。

entries.source:
Welcome #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#.
You are a citizen of the Sunwall, and like many of your age you have been trained in combat and magic. It can be a harsh life, and though you dream at times of venturing to distant lands you know your duty is to help defend the outpost against the vicious onslaught from the Orc Prides. But now High Sun Paladin Aeryn has advised you of a new threat.

Nagas have been sighted in the Slazish Fens on the other side of the Sunwall Mountains. Their objective is unclear, but an assault from both sides would be truly devastating at such a pivotal time for your people. Though there are few forces to spare on the front line against the Prides, you have volunteered to investigate the naga threat and stop them if need be.

By the power of the Sun and the blessings of the Moons you step forth to find your fate.
entries.target:
欢迎你 #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#！
你是太阳堡垒的成员，和许多同龄人一样，你受过战斗与魔法训练。
这是一段残酷的生活，你有时梦想去遥远的土地冒险，但你也知道你的使命是帮助抵御兽人部落凶猛的攻势、保卫前哨站。但现在，高阶太阳骑士艾琳告诉了你一个新的威胁。

在太阳堡垒群山的另一边斯拉伊什沼泽发现了娜迦的踪迹。他们的目的还未查明，但在这个对你的人民至关重要的时刻，如果同时受到两边夹击，后果将是毁灭性的。
但是已经很难从前线对付兽人部落的部队里抽调人员了，你自愿前去调查娜迦的威胁，如有必要就阻止他们。

在太阳之力和月亮的祝福下，你迈步向前寻找你的宿命。

entries.source: The orb seems to fizzle without the Blood Master.
entries.target: 没有血之领主在场，水晶球似乎只是发出嘶嘶声，无法生效。

entries.source: Fought the two Sorcerers and closed three invocation portals.
entries.target: 在关闭3扇传送门的情况下，杀死2名巫师。
一名正在训练中的心灵杀手。

entries.target: #DARK_GREY#你的戒指释放出一股死灵能量！

entries.source:
As you walk toward the Daikara you can not fail to notice the huge volcano that erupts in the center of it, right where the path is taking you.
You see pyroclasts ejected from the heart of the volcano, they look relatively harmless but very impressive.
entries.target:
当你走向岱卡拉时，你不可能注意不到岱卡拉中心的巨大火山正在喷发，那正是小路通向的地方。
你看到火山口喷出火山碎屑，看起来相对无害，却令人印象深刻。

entries.source: You walk three different timelines, choosing the one you prefer at the end (current timeline: %d).
entries.target: 你可以从三条时间线中选择一条进入(当前时间线：%d)。

entries.source:
Your Forge Shield talent now increases your Armour by %d, your Defense by %d, and gives you %0.2f psi when you're hit by a melee or ranged attack.
		The bonuses will scale with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
你的熔炉屏障技能现在可以增加你 %d 点护甲，%d 点闪避，并且当你被近战或远程攻击击中时给予你 %0.2f 灵能值。
		受精神强度影响，增益按比例加成。

entries.source: Killed Shasshhiy'Kaish after letting her grow as powerful as possible.
entries.target: 在莎西·凯希成长到尽可能强大之后杀死她。

entries.source:
An invigorating ray of Sunlight shines upon you, healing your body for %d life.
		The amount healed will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
一束充满活力的阳光照耀着你，治疗你 %d 点生命值。
		治疗量受法术强度加成。
